Gamepad mode requires the ViGEmBus driver (open source, signed by Microsoft, version {bundled}, ~6 MB).
Clicking 'Install' will trigger a UAC prompt. Installation takes ~30 seconds.

ViGEmBus driver {version} is ready, but the Python vgamepad library is not installed.
Click 'Install dependency' to pip-install (prefers wheel, skips driver installer), ~10 seconds. If a ViGEmBus installer wizard appears, just close it — your existing driver is unaffected.

The ViGEmBus driver isn't ready right now. Reinstalling it once will fix it.
Click 'Reinstall' to repair now (~30 seconds).

Driver files are written but not loaded yet.
Click 'Reinstall' to install again (usually works immediately), or reboot your PC and come back.

about.title: About TEGG Touch
about.description:
TEGG Touch is a free, open-source accessibility tool.

With just simple mouse movements and clicks, TEGG Touch can replace most game controls. We hope it helps those in need and brings the joy of gaming to everyone.

wheel_style.title: Wheel Style Manager
wheel_style.desc_small:
8 directional sectors, compact.
Ideal for scenarios that only require 8-way movement without extra actions during movement.
e.g. moving character in Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor.
Note: Defaults to WASD 8-way directions, but can be remapped.
wheel_style.desc_large:
8 directional sectors + optional center ring.
Center ring can bind separate keys, ideal for inspecting items, looting, and opening chests while moving the camera.
Note: Defaults to WASD 8-way directions, but can be remapped.
wheel_style.desc_double:
Center ring + Middle ring + 8-way sectors.
Three independent layers for complex setups.
Note: Defaults to WASD 8-way directions, but can be remapped.
wheel_style.desc_dual:
Center ring + Inner 8-way (WASD) + Outer 8-way (Shift+WASD).
Two rings of directional keys, ideal for run/walk toggle scenarios.
Note: Inner defaults to WASD, outer defaults to Shift+WASD, both remappable.
wheel_style.ring_mode_tip_whole: Whole ring: a single circular button
wheel_style.ring_mode_tip_quad: Diagonal quad split: top / right / bottom / left
wheel_style.ring_mode_tip_octa: 8 directional sectors, same as the outer ring

gp_wheel_editor.title: Steering Wheel Editor
gp_wheel_editor.tip: The wheel is a 4×2 singleton item composed of [Left LT bar + Center disk + Right RT bar]. The entire area responds to mouse: horizontal distance controls steering; LT/RT respond to the mode selected below.
gp_wheel_editor.name: Name
gp_wheel_editor.release_threshold_hint: When the cursor distance from the rectangle's horizontal center exceeds (half-width × threshold), steering + LT + RT all reset. Re-enter to reactivate.
gp_wheel_editor.vertical_hint: Mouse Y up = increase, down = decrease (accumulated Δ)
gp_wheel_editor.buttons_hint: Hold LMB → increase, hold RMB → decrease (add step every N ms)
gp_wheel_editor.err_mutual_buttons: ⚠ LT and RT cannot both use 'L/R Buttons' (LMB/RMB conflict)
